episodes.focal_question: 金融机构如何处理FATF确定的21类上游犯罪？
episodes.title: 依据FATF分类承认并监控上游犯罪

elements.label: FATF has identified 21 categories of predicate offenses
financial institutions must acknowledge and monitor these offenses under AML compliance programs

relations.source_quote: FATF has identified 21 categories of predicate offenses that financial institutions must acknowledge and monitor under AML compliance programs.

episodes.focal_question: 受监管实体如何应对制裁规避风险？
episodes.title: 建立反洗钱和制裁合规计划以检测和预防制裁规避

elements.label: need for detecting and preventing sanctions evasion
regulated entities must have strong AML and sanctions compliance programs with robust policies, procedures, and internal controls

relations.source_quote: Regulated entities must have strong AML and sanctions compliance programs with robust policies, procedures, and internal controls for detecting and preventing sanctions evasion.

episodes.focal_question: 银行合规官如何通过调查揭露非法活动？

elements.label: compliance officer flagged irregular payment flows linked to RedStar
exposed the illicit network, revealing Komarov and Volkof Industries' role in sanctions evasion, proliferation financing, laundering criminal proceeds, and foreign bribery and corruption offences

episodes.focal_question: 跨境背景下如何协调风险控制与多法域法律？
episodes.title: 协调风险控制以适应跨境法律差异

elements.label: variation in classification of predicate offenses across jurisdictions can complicate AML efforts
compliance professionals operating in cross-border contexts need to align risk controls with the laws and regulations of more than one jurisdiction

relations.source_quote: This variation can complicate AML efforts, with compliance professionals operating in cross-border contexts needing to align risk controls with the laws and regulations of more than one jurisdiction.

candidate_audit.reason: 该候选提供了金融机构必须根据FATF分类承认并监控上游犯罪这一程序性要求，已建模为参考标准动作。
该候选的核心是受监管实体必须建立合规计划这一程序性要求，已建模；所列处罚为静态法律后果，不构成业务流程，未建模。
该候选的核心是合规官通过调查揭露非法网络的过程，符合流程定义；案例背景细节未作为独立流程建模。
该候选提供了跨境背景下合规专业人士必须协调风险控制这一过程要求，已建模。
